items.title: 13.10.2 Garam aabi sodium hydroxide ke saath reaction (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 13.10.2 with Quick Check 13.5, printed pages 300-301.

blocks.text: Jab chlorine garam aqueous sodium hydroxide (NaOH) se react karti hai to sodium chloride (NaCl) aur sodium chlorate (V) (NaClO₃) banati hai. Yeh bhi disproportionation reaction ki misal hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ne equation 3Cl₂ + 6NaOH → NaCl + NaClO₃ + 3H₂O chhapi hai, jo balanced nahi (baen taraf 6 Cl aur 6 Na, daen taraf sirf 2). Sahi equation mein NaCl se pehle 5 aata hai: paanch Cl atoms -1 tak reduce hote hain aur ek Cl atom +5 tak oxidize hota hai.
Chlorine NaClO₃ mein 0 se +5 tak oxidize hoti hai, aur NaCl mein 0 se -1 tak reduce hoti hai.

Yeh disproportionation reaction dikhata hai ke reaction ka temperature banne wale products ko kaise badal deta hai, aur chlorine redox reactions mein kitni versatile (har tarah ke kaam kar sakne wali) hai.

blocks.prompt: a) KI concentrated H₂SO₄ se kaise react karta hai? Yeh iodide ki reducing power ke bare mein kya batata hai?
blocks.explanation: Pehle KI + H₂SO₄ → KHSO₄ + HI. Phir HI acid ko reduce karta hai: 8HI + H₂SO₄ → 4I₂ + H₂S + 4H₂O. Banafshi iodine ke dhuen aur H₂S ki boo aati hai. Sulfur +6 se -2 tak reduce hota hai, jo dikhata hai ke iodide bohat taqatwar reducing agent hai, bromide (sirf SO₂ tak) aur chloride (bilkul nahi) se kahin zyada.

blocks.prompt: b) Dikhayein ke Cl₂ ka thande aur garam aqueous KOH ke saath reaction disproportionation hai.
blocks.explanation: Thanda: Cl₂ + 2KOH → KCl + KClO + H₂O; chlorine 0 se KCl mein -1 (reduce) aur KClO mein +1 (oxidize). Garam: 3Cl₂ + 6KOH → 5KCl + KClO₃ + 3H₂O; chlorine 0 se -1 (paanch atoms) aur +5 (ek atom). Dono mein ek hi element oxidize aur reduce dono hota hai, is liye dono disproportionation hain.

blocks.prompt: c) HI taqatwar reducing agent hai. Chemical reactions se wazahat karein.
blocks.explanation: HI concentrated sulfuric acid ko H₂S tak reduce karta hai aur khud I₂ ban jata hai: 8HI + H₂SO₄ → 4I₂ + H₂S + 4H₂O (S: +6 se -2, I: -1 se 0). Is ke muqable mein HBr acid ko sirf SO₂ tak reduce karta hai: 2HBr + H₂SO₄ → Br₂ + SO₂ + 2H₂O (S: +6 se +4). Sulfur ko zyada gehra reduce karna dikhata hai ke HI zyada taqatwar reducing agent hai.

items: Temperature tay karta hai ke chlorate(I) banega (thanda) ya chlorate(V) (garam).
